apps.name: Plezy
apps.subtitle: Modern cross-platform Plex client
apps.localizedDescription: A modern Plex client built with Flutter for native performance and a clean interface. Stream your media library with a beautiful, responsive UI.

versions.localizedDescription:
## Playback

- Large MKVs on Android resume and seek immediately
- Dolby Vision plays through the Dolby Vision decoder on Android
- Opus, Vorbis, and FLAC tracks play instead of stalling on Android

## Downloads

- An unreachable downloaded file streams from the server on Android

## Profiles & startup

- The profile prompt no longer interrupts a companion-remote session

## tvOS

- Siri Remote navigation matches native tvOS pacing
- A single flick moves exactly one item
- Rail and hub-row scrolling glides instead of snapping

## New features

- Live TV recording on Jellyfin and Emby
- Match Content Resolution on Android TV
- FFmpeg demuxes every container on Android
- Anchored grouping, filter, and sort menus on desktop
- Cmd+, / Ctrl+, opens settings
- Full details sheet from the TV detail hero

## Performance

- Cold start reaches the first screen ~500 ms sooner
- D-pad browse on TV drops far fewer frames
- Player chrome no longer rebuilds on every tick
- Artwork nothing displays is no longer decoded

## Playback

- Downloaded subtitles apply instead of failing
- Quoted mpv.conf values take effect

## New features

- Search results can be filtered by media type
- The sidebar is restyled as an M3 Expressive navigation rail

## Playback

- Playback stats show the source audio track and codec during passthrough
- Compressed embedded MKV subtitles render on the ExoPlayer path
- Android MPV no longer shows a blue screen for hardware-decoded HEVC on Nvidia Shield

## Plex

- Artwork is requested at native size instead of server-side upscales

## Jellyfin & Emby

- Items removed from Emby Continue Watching no longer reappear

## Explore & trackers

## New features

- Multi-version movies and episodes get a split Play button
- Player changes can be saved globally, per library, per show or movie, or not at all
- Search results show their source server and library
- Plex artist pages group albums by release type
- Connected MDBList watchlists can be selected in Explore
- iOS and tvOS system video controls add skip buttons

## Playback

- Video starts faster through cached metadata and parallelized setup
- Play actions show loading feedback during fetches
- Network prefetching removes gaps between music tracks
- ExoPlayer seeks correctly in MKVs with late track metadata
- Android MPV renders software-decoded Dolby Vision correctly
- Compatible Android routes can bitstream DTS-HD MA
- Android falls back to FFmpeg DTS decoding when passthrough is unavailable
- Android passthrough only enables compatible audio routes
- Plex Live TV can select and burn embedded DVB subtitles

## New features

- Audio and subtitle sync sliders cover ±10 seconds in 50 ms steps
- The bundled ffmpeg enables the loudnorm filter for volume normalization

## Playback

- Plex video transcodes use fMP4 HLS, so HEVC presets stop corrupting
- Plex transcodes seek in-band instead of pre-warming at the resume offset
- Same-day Specials no longer hijack up next
- Episode advances that fail on a transient server blip are retried
- Playback no longer fails when a preference write is refused
- TrueHD offers its MAT carrier on Android 10–12 audio routes
- Timeline heartbeats stop once a Plex server terminates the session
- ExoPlayer track labels say AAC instead of mp4a.40.2
- Emby scrub previews load from the server's BIF index
- iOS and tvOS keep HDR and Dolby Vision when the video is zoomed
- tvOS schedules frames with more presentation lead
